sourceEncoding.description: Required for CSV after default/detection; null for XLSX.

sourceDelimiter.description: Selected/detected CSV delimiter; null for XLSX.

mapping.description: Per-sheet header/column/reference maps plus optional fixedCategoryId and fixedBrandId. Fixed IDs must reference ACTIVE entities; CSV options are immutable run fields and are not part of mapping.

parserVersion.description: Version that generated the bounded raw source rows.

sourceParseIssues.schema: bounded code/message diagnostics without file or cell content

checks: CSV sourceEncoding/sourceDelimiter are non-null and XLSX values are null
CatalogImportRun.immutability: source file reference, source format, source parsing options, parser version and sourceParseIssues are immutable; mapping changes only before any APPLIED/REJECTED row; run is never physically deleted.

sourceCells.schema: typed source cells including optional number format; max 128 columns and 4000 Unicode code points per stored cell

normalizedCandidate.schema: existing CatalogProduct + CatalogProductRevision candidate fields and typed ProductAttributeValue candidates

CatalogImportRow.immutability: source coordinates and sourceCells are immutable; current normalized/match/state values may change only in audited mapping/preview/decision transactions.

conflictCode.description: Persisted HTTP 409 code for outcome=CONFLICT; null for all other outcomes.

checks: reasonCode in declared enum when present
outcome=CONFLICT requires a DENIED catalog.import.row.decided AuditEvent and null targetProductId/resultRevisionId
outcome=CONFLICT iff conflictCode is IMPORT_ROW_CONFLICT or IDENTITY_CONFLICT; all other outcomes require conflictCode null
CatalogImportDecision.immutability: Append-only; at most one decision per (rowId,idempotencyKey). Same-key/same-hash retry returns the stored result without a duplicate decision or audit event.

invariants: No source file bytes, raw cell values, normalized product text, supplier prices, secrets, or storage keys are copied to AuditEvent.
A successful decision, CatalogProduct/CatalogProductRevision mutation, ImportRow update, CatalogImportDecision, and success AuditEvent share one PostgreSQL transaction.
CatalogImportRun uploaderStaffUserId must equal the referenced PRIVATE FileObject ownerStaffUserId.
Each row decision is a separate command and accepts at most one row.
ImportRun source SHA/size/MIME/name are read from the immutable referenced FileVersion; no duplicate mutable metadata is stored.
CatalogImportRun and CatalogImportRow are never physically deleted by API.
CatalogImportRun uploaderStaffUserId defines default visibility; catalog.products.read alone never grants access to another staff user's raw import rows.

Cross-owner reads require an ACTIVE actor whose effective permission union contains all FROZEN R1-002 controlAdminRequiredPermissions plus catalog.products.read; cross-owner mapping/preview/decisions additionally require catalog.products.write and catalog.references.read. Role names do not grant either scope.
Mapping, preview and row decisions require catalog.references.read when resolving or revalidating Brand, Category or AttributeDefinition references; no reference is created automatically.

For ACCEPT_CREATE/ACCEPT_REVISION conflicts, catalog mutation rolls back first; row candidateState=CONFLICT, one decision outcome=CONFLICT and one DENIED AuditEvent are then committed atomically. Audit failure rolls back the conflict record transaction.
A same-key/same-hash retry returns the stored decision result without a second decision or audit event; same-key/different-hash returns IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED without a new decision.
Cross-owner access is recorded in catalog.import.cross_owner.accessed without raw cells, filenames, file bytes, or storage keys.
A fixedCategoryId excludes categoryId column/reference mappings and requires every attribute mapping on that sheet to use the same categoryId; fixedBrandId excludes brandId column/reference mappings.
